basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Project Technician (Civil Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, has invited applications for one Project Technician post in the project "Evaluation of Local Aggregates with the required Stabilisation Technique for Pavement Layers". The appointment is for 11 months at Rs. 18000 pay (total Rs. 19250 with medical, no HRA), and the qualification is a Diploma in Civil Engineering. Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment) on or before 25 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The offline interview is on 30 November 2026 at 04.00 pm

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati: https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment.
Search for the project title as printed in this advertisement to reach the relevant position.
Follow the instructions and guidelines given on the portal.
Apply on or before 25 November 2026 (5:00 PM).
For technical help with the online application, call 0361-258-2759 or email [email protected].
Application status can also be seen from the application portal. For any clarification, contact Principal Investigator Prof. Anjan Kumar S, email [email protected], phone 0361-258 3332.
important_instructions: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The interview is offline, on 30 November 2026 (Monday) at 04.00 pm, at the Meeting Room, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail about the mode of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview.
